title: Wi-Tek WI-R3 1200M Dual Band Wireless PoE Switch / Router

items.h: PoE input and PoE passthrough support
Cloud management and centralized network control

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wi‑Tek WI‑R3 1200M Dual Band Wireless PoE Router is a reliable and high-performance networking solution designed for small offices, surveillance systems, and home networks. With dual-band Wi-Fi technology, it delivers combined wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps, including 300Mbps on the 2.4GHz band for wider coverage and 867Mbps on the 5GHz band for faster data transmission.


This powerful router also works as a PoE switch, allowing it to power compatible network devices such as IP cameras and wireless access points. It features four Ethernet ports (1 WAN + 3 LAN) for stable wired connections and supports PoE input and PoE passthrough, making it ideal for CCTV installations and network expansion.


The Wi-Tek WI-R3 supports cloud management and centralized configuration, allowing administrators to monitor and manage the network remotely. With high-gain antennas, advanced wireless security, and stable connectivity, it ensures smooth internet access and reliable wireless coverage.


The Wi-Tek WI-R3 Dual-Band Wireless PoE Router is an excellent choice for offices, retail stores, hotels, schools, and surveillance networks, providing efficient network performance and flexible deployment options.


Key Features


  • Dual-Band Wi-Fi speed up to 1200Mbps
  • 300Mbps (2.4GHz) + 867Mbps (5GHz) wireless performance
  • Built-in PoE switch for powering network devices
  • 1 × WAN + 3 × LAN Ethernet ports
  • PoE input and PoE passthrough support
  • High-gain external antennas for wider coverage
  • Cloud management and centralized network control
  • Ideal for CCTV systems, offices, and business networks
